title: Add New Service
subtitle: Create a new service for your salon with pricing and duration details.
confirmSubtitle: Please review the service information and translations before creating.
serviceNameHelp: Enter the name of the service you want to create
descriptionHelp: Optional description of what the service includes
serviceGroupHelp: Use groups to structure your services on the salon page.
categoryHelp: Choose a category to organize your services
durationHelp: Enter duration in minutes (e.g., 60 for 1 hour)
priceHelp: Enter price in Vietnamese Dong (numbers only, e.g., 50000)
addServiceGroupHelp: Create a group to organize your services (e.g., "Hair services", "Nails").
staffHelp: Select staff members who can perform this service. All staff are selected by default.
